title: Plug-and-Play Sensor Evolution in Software-Defined Vehicles through Asset Administration Shells
abstract: arXiv:2611.23298v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software-defined vehicles (SDVs) promise continuous software evolution, but sensor integration in deployed vehicles still depends on manual configuration, hardware-specific drivers, and repeated application-side adaptation. Existing standards address only parts of this problem. AUTOSAR standardizes selected sensor interfaces, the Vehicle Signal Specification (VSS) standardizes signal semantics, and Asset Administration Shells (AAS) standardize digital asset descriptions. However, these building blocks are rarely combined into an end-to-end onboarding path for sensors attached after vehicle deployment.   This paper presents an AAS-driven plug-and-play sensor integration framework for safety-supervised sensors. Each sensor is represented by an AAS that combines hardware identification, interface metadata, VSS mappings, and references to containerized driver and optional application software. translated_title: 通过资产管理壳实现软件定义汽车中的即插即用传感器演进
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.23298v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：软件定义汽车承诺持续的软件演进，但已部署车辆中的传感器集成仍然依赖手动配置、硬件专用驱动程序以及应用侧的反复适配。现有标准仅解决了该问题的一部分：AUTOSAR标准化了部分传感器接口，车辆信号规范（VSS）标准化了信号语义，而资产管理壳（AAS）标准化了数字资产描述。然而，这些构建模块很少被组合成一条端到端的接入路径，用于车辆部署后新增的传感器。本文提出了一种由AAS驱动的、面向安全监督传感器的即插即用传感器集成框架。每个传感器由一个AAS表示，该AAS结合了硬件识别信息、接口元数据、VSS映射，以及指向容器化驱动程序和可选应用软件的引用。在物理连接之后，边缘网关识别……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种基于资产管理壳（AAS）的即插即用传感器集成框架，使软件定义汽车在部署后新增传感器时能够自动完成识别、配置与安全监督下的软件部署。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an AAS-driven plug-and-play sensor integration framework that enables automatic identification, configuration, and safety-supervised software deployment of sensors added to software-defined vehicles after deployment.
